_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Open the gates of righteousness; let us go in.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.
Spread your cloaks; the King rides toward the city.
Hosanna! Blessed is the King!
If we were silent, the very stones would cry out.
Hosanna in the highest! Come, let us worship.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Throw your cloak in the road, pull the branch from the tree — the King is coming, riding low on a borrowed colt.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
The whole crowd of disciples is shouting, the road is loud with praise, and even the stones are ready to sing.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
Open to us the gates of righteousness; this is the day the Lord has made.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
Hosanna in the highest! Bind the procession with branches and come.
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Cloaks and branches cover the road; the King rides in.
Hosanna! Blessed is the King!
The stones themselves would shout if we kept still.
Hosanna! Blessed is the King!
Open the gates; come, let us worship.
Hosanna! Blessed is the King! Amen.
